headline: Sundaram Finance reports 6% rise in Q2 profit

headline: Sundaram Finance reports 5.9% rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 517 crore
hook: Steady profit growth at Sundaram Finance
summary: Sundaram Finance announced its financial results for the second quarter of FY27, reporting a 5.9% year-on-year increase in net profit to ₹517 crore. This compares with ₹488 crore recorded in the same period last year. Net interest income grew 21.1% to ₹1,016 crore, up from ₹839 crore in Q2FY26. Retail investors tracking non-banking financial companies can gauge the lender's credit demand and margin trends from these numbers.
